conversations: William Shakespeare wrote Romeo and Juliet.
Socrates was a classical Greek philosopher credited as one of the founders of Western philosophy.
Plato was an ancient Greek philosopher, student of Socrates, and founder of the Academy in Athens.
Aristotle was an ancient Greek philosopher and polymath who was tutored by Plato and taught Alexander the Great.
Mythology refers to a collection of myths or traditional stories belong to a particular religion or cultural tradition.
